description: This file declares functions related to value change notifications in the RBus messaging framework, including adding and removing property nodes and closing handles. It appears to be a header file defining interfaces used by other source files.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_AddPropertyNode
methods.description: Adds a property node to the RBus handle for value change notifications.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_RemovePropertyNode
methods.description: Removes a property node from the RBus handle.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes or releases the RBus handle.
